# frozen-final-service

create frozen-final-service Postgres GORM JWT JSON

## Run

    go mod tidy
    go test ./...
    go build ./...
    go run ./cmd/server

Health: http://localhost:8080/healthz

Secrets belong in environment variables. Never commit .env, PEM or key files.

## Database

Generated gorm adapter for postgres. Set DATABASE_DSN to check the configured connection at server startup, or call database.Open from your application layer. Without DATABASE_DSN, the health server starts without a database connection. /healthz does not assert database readiness.
Call database.Migrate only against a separately approved database target; the example is a schema_versions table and is not run at server startup. The Agent runs SQLite connection/migration tests in temporary databases; it never connects to your database. PostgreSQL/MySQL connection and migration require your isolated test environment.
## Authentication

Generated jwt middleware. Set AUTH_SECRET to at least 32 characters. The private endpoint rejects requests when credentials are missing. Add your user identity validation before issuing tokens; no default username or password is provided.
Token lifetime: 24h. JWT revocation is not provided by this stateless skeleton; rotate the key or add a deny list. Session storage is process memory and all sessions expire on restart; it is not shared between instances.
